_comment: gate_mode is warn (notice only) or enforce (refuse); any other value reads as enforce. Compiled-in identity constants for the account system (ADR-0029 SR-8). Nothing in a project, a preference or the environment overrides them; the only seam is the loopback test seam of SR-44. Every REPLACE-ME value is a placeholder to be filled in at release time. A build whose values are still placeholders rejects every token. A prod build ships only the prod environment (SR-27).
